description: Unofficial PC runtime that plays the Smash Hit Gear VR build in a PC VR headset (OpenXR) or flat. Bring your own APK.
notes: ShatterVR contains no game. Copy your own Smash Hit Gear VR APK to:
It is kept when ShatterVR is updated or uninstalled (a copy is stored in $persist_dir).
Then start ShatterVR from the Start menu (start your VR software first to play in the headset).
pre_install: # Bring back the APK from earlier installs (kept in the persist folder).
post_install: if (-not (Test-Path "$dir\game.apk")) { Write-Host "Copy your own Smash Hit Gear VR APK to $dir\game.apk before playing." -ForegroundColor Yellow }

script: # Keep the APK (it is the user's own file) for the next version or a reinstall.
